title: Thread-Safe LRU Cache
summary: O(1) get/put with a hash map plus a hand-written doubly linked list, eviction callbacks, and safety under concurrent access.
hints: A map from key to node, plus a doubly linked list with **sentinel** head and tail nodes. That removes every null check.
`get`: on a hit, unlink the node and insert it after head. `put`: update and move to front, or insert at the front, then evict `tail.prev` if over capacity.
Call `onEvict` with the evicted entry. Updating an existing key is **not** an eviction.
`get` mutates the order, so a read-write lock doesn't help. Use a single mutex, and keep the critical section O(1).
